questions.question: Explain why only ~10% of energy transfers between trophic levels

points.text: Energy lost as: heat (respiration), faeces (undigested), urine (excretion), uneaten parts. Only energy in consumed biomass available to next level. 2nd law of thermodynamics: entropy increases
